housing.text: Putz's platform says he will address rising housing costs by building more homes while protecting renters.
housing.quote: tackle rising housing costs by building smarter and protecting renters

schools.text: Putz says every child deserves a strong public school, emphasizing investment in public education.
schools.quote: Every child deserves a strong public school and a fair shot at success

health.text: Supports expanding local health care access and said he was open to exploring universal health care solutions.
health.quote: In discussing his priorities, Randall said California, as the fourth largest economy in the world, can lead on protecting civil liberties and advancing fair immigration policy, while also tackling housing affordability, homelessness, rural healthcare access, and exploring universal healthcare solutions, expressing confidence that his regional experience will help him deliver results in Sacramento.

tax.text: Hughes says he would work to eliminate the gas tax and opposes new taxes, advocating a middle-class tax cut.
tax.quote: Work to eliminate the gas tax, lowering the cost of fuel, groceries, and housing.

housing.text: Hughes says California needs more housing and would reduce permitting delays and fees while expanding housing funds, though he also supports local control over growth.
housing.quote: California needs more housing, but Sacramento’s one-size-fits-all mandates are not working for rural communities.

schools.text: Hughes supports expanding school choice so parents decide where their children are educated.
schools.quote: Expanding school choice, so parents, not government officials, decide where their children are educated.

safety.text: Hughes opposes defunding the police and pledges to ensure law enforcement has the resources and protections it needs.
safety.quote: protecting the Peace Officer's Bill of Rights, ensuring law enforcement has the resources and protections needed to do their jobs effectively.

sentencing.text: Hughes calls for reinstating the death penalty and ending early release policies.
sentencing.quote: Ending early release policies, keeping dangerous criminals off our streets.

health.text: Hughes says he would work to ensure Medi-Cal patients can access care close to home and supports rural health services.
health.quote: Rural communities need better access to doctors, mental health providers, and emergency care. I would work to expand telehealth, support mobile clinics, recruit providers to underserved areas, and ensure Medi-Cal patients can actually access care close to home.

energy.text: Hughes supports energy reliability and responsible renewable development but would limit large solar projects near homes, wildlife habitat, and existing neighborhoods.
energy.quote: I support energy reliability and responsible renewable energy development, but desert communities should not be treated like dumping grounds for industrial projects.
